_about: One whole resume, reviewed the way Stage 1 reviews it: every experience and project bullet, in chunks, with no requirement deciding who gets read. These are the owner's real entries in their vague form — the resume that produced two reviewed bullets and one question in run f03279a8 against a Google-style backend posting. There is no `expect` field and nothing passes or fails: the point is to read all fifteen decisions and judge whether the reviewer's opinion of the thirteen bullets it has never seen is worth wiring into the planner. `match_findings` mirror what the fit engine actually produced for that run — C/C++ explicit on the robotics work, the grouped requirement inferred, everything else unmatched.
